Renting the home out for more than three years forfeits the federal home-sale capital-gains exclusion, which requires 2 of the last 5 years as a principal residence (IRC §121). A later sale while living out of state also triggers Hawaiʻi's HARPTA withholding of 7.25% of the sale price.
